claim: Documentation, no new theorem. Read against the contact-first native-network gate, compositions of the knot's spaces pass the substrate, native-law (substitution with multiplicative amplitudes), endpoint-identity (splice calculus) and persistence (switching, relabelling, transpose) items, and fail the no-common-hub item: every composition passes through an equality hub (KNOT-COMPOSE A), and hub-free failure exists only for parity. So the knot's spaces form a native network of knots with network hubs (in scope by the owner's 2026-10-29 decision), not a hub-free contact network; whether such networks give native paths and separation is open (2/3).
conclusion: The knot's spaces compose natively only as networks of knots joined by hubs; hub-free composition is parity's.
